entities.summary: Leopold Maximiliaan Felix Timmermans is a much translated author from Flanders. He was nominated for the Nobel Prize in Literature three times. Felix Timmermans was a authors & novelists from Lier (1886-07-05, Lier–1947-01-24). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Its legacy: Created literary works of enduring influence.
